title: Downstream Inference
goal: Satisfy type constraints when passing bindings to functions expecting specific primitive types.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1: Types and Values

hints: Look at what type takes_u32 requires for val.
If val is u32, takes_u8 still needs a u8 argument.
explanation: `takes_u32(val)` forces `val` to be `u32`. Binding `val = value` retains the `u32` type without conversion. When passing `val` to `takes_u8`, you must explicitly convert it with `val as u8`. Setting `val = value as u8` causes `takes_u32(val)` to fail with `E0308` because `val` is now `u8` instead of `u32`.
